body.statement: The score \(\widehat G_m\) constructed by \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{eff}}\) belongs to \(\mathcal H_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}\) almost surely, and its induced main-wave design has exact acceptance mass \(\alpha\) and support bounded below by \(\eta/|\Omega_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}|\).
body.justification: Efficient score estimation must not compromise finite randomization validity or positive inclusion probabilities.
body.gap: Pilot plug-in rerandomization is first-order valid in Han and Deng, but the exact-alpha positive-support normalization here is a distinct finite construction.
body.consumer: It makes the learned rule auditable before any asymptotic risk comparison is invoked.
